title: Front garden renewal in Oak Bay

seo.title: Sample project: Oak Bay front garden renewal
seo.description: Sample case study: an Oak Bay front lawn replaced with deer-resistant planting, a flagstone path and drip lines, kept clear of a protected tree.

summary: A tired lawn and overgrown beds replaced with deer-resistant planting and a stone path.
scope: Flagstone path to the front door
challenge: Deer had eaten most of the old planting, the lawn browned every summer, and a protected tree stood near the boulevard where the new path would run.
approach: Before digging we confirmed the tree's status under Oak Bay's Tree Protection Bylaw and kept all excavation outside its root zone.

We lifted the lawn, amended the soil and set a flagstone path to the front door, then planted shrubs and perennials that deer tend to leave alone. Drip lines went in under the mulch, and the owners got written care notes for the first summer.
result: A front garden suited to deer pressure and dry summers, with less lawn to water.
links: Read more about [landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/), see our work in [Oak Bay](/areas/oak-bay/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
story: Deer had eaten most of the old planting, and the lawn struggled in summer.

We checked the protected tree near the boulevard before digging, kept work outside its root zone, and planted lavender, rosemary, sword fern, Oregon grape and other plants deer tend to leave alone. Drip lines went in under the mulch.
